name: Cuisinart Supreme Grind (DBM-8)
details: Electric burr mill with 18 settings (dots). Also sold as the Professional Burr Mill.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.
notes.espresso: Honest Coffee Guide lists no espresso range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): moka pot 1–3, AeroPress 1–7, V60 1–4, filter coffee machine 1–6, French press 5–10, cold brew 6–12; Turkish, espresso N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. The guide stops at 12 because coarser settings are past 1400 µm.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
